We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The scenario: a blasting worker (爆破员) and safety officer together used 720kg of emulsion explosive and 30 detonators to perform blasting on a highway. The worker had a blasting certificate but according to regulations cannot independently conduct blasting; he violated and performed explosion, causing flying stones to hit a villager, killing him. So the crime is likely "非法使用爆炸物罪" or "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide) or "非法制造、买卖、运输、储存、使用爆炸物罪". Chinese criminal law: Article 122 (dangerous means) maybe "非法使用爆炸物罪" (illegal use of explosive). Also "过失致人死亡罪" (negligent homicide). The facts: He performed blasting illegally, causing death. The appropriate charge: "非法使用爆炸物罪" (illegal use of explosives) and "过失致人死亡罪". However examples: In previous examples, they gave single label like "非法获取公民个人信息", "破坏计算机信息系统", "行贿", "拐骗儿童", "信用卡诈骗", "非国家工作人员受贿", "故意伤害;故意毁坏财物", "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章". So they combine multiple crimes separated by semicolon. For this case, likely "非法使用爆炸物罪;过失致人死亡罪". But need to see typical Chinese law classification: Using explosives without proper authorization causing death may be "非法使用爆炸物罪" (Article 122) which includes causing death, property damage. Also "过失致人死亡罪" is separate. Which is more appropriate? The fact says he violated safety regulations, cannot independently conduct blasting, and his illegal blasting caused death. The prosecution likely charges "非法使用爆炸物罪" (illegal use of explosives) and maybe "过失致人死亡罪". In Chinese criminal law, illegal use of explosives causing death may be punished under that article, not separate negligent homicide. But could be both. The examples show they sometimes include multiple crimes if facts support. For example, the case with assault and property damage gave both "故意伤害;故意毁坏财物". So here we have both illegal use of explosives and causing death (negligent homicide). So answer: [罪名]非法使用爆炸物罪;过失致人死亡罪<eoa>
